body:
The owner lifted the freeze on 2026-10-12 and wants the hourly agents (`oss1`–`oss4`) to build a new set of projects here. Since 2026-10-01 every scheduled run has replied "frozen" and stopped. The move to fp-monorepo (Duncan-Haywood/fp-monorepo#6143) is on hold; its copy of `research/` dates from 2026-10-01.

## Changes
- **`PROJECTS.md` (new):** six priority tracks. Each has a goal, prior work, milestones sized for one run, a slug prefix and site theme, and guardrails:
  1. Self-replicating manufacturing (`selfrep`): closure, vitamins, what to build next, growth, reinvest or produce.
  2. Ambient AI assistant (`ambient`): audio-first pipeline, when to speak, Android prototype, wearable design. Discreet, not covert.
  3. LLM chip design loops (`chip`): open EDA flow, RTL and PPA loops, a small accelerator, SKY130 place and route.
  4. General-purpose robot manufacturing loops (`robofab`): assembly sequencing, insertion, LLM programs checked in a twin, cell scheduling.
  5. Simulation-first design (`simdesign`): CAD as code, finite elements, topology optimisation, fidelity ladder, manufacturability.
  6. Engineered clothing (`garment`): designer-garment cost teardown, fit by cloth simulation, nesting, thermal and optical fabrics, protective tailoring, athletic assist, smart garments.
- **Rules shared by all tracks:** simulate first; keep the toolchain open and in-house; compare LLM proposers with non-LLM baselines at equal budgets; label agent-written proposals honestly; leave hardware, purchases and physical tests to the owner.
- **`prompt.md`:** drops the freeze note and points new work at `PROJECTS.md`. Runs leave alone the branches that only hold `prompts/` run-log lines (26 of the 54 unmerged branches).
- **`CLAUDE.md`, `README.md`:** drop the freeze and move notices.

No project under `research/` changes. `python site/build.py` prints `ok: 233 projects, 2146 tests`.
